description: Return a bounded monthly trend for one state and one FBI summarized UCR offense category from LiveDataLink's self-hosted official CDE aggregate snapshot. Fields include reported offenses and clearances, rates per 100,000 reporting population, full and reporting populations, coverage percentage, pagination, and exact provenance. Use this for 'California violent-crime trend in 2023', 'monthly motor vehicle theft reported in Texas', or 'did coverage change during this state trend?'. Crimes known to law enforcement only; never use for cross-state rankings or individual decisions.

end_month.description: Calendar month in YYYY-MM format within the hosted snapshot.

offense.description: FBI CDE summarized offense category. Aggregate categories overlap their component offenses.

response_format.description: Human-readable markdown or machine-readable JSON. Default markdown.

start_month.description: Calendar month in YYYY-MM format within the hosted snapshot.

state.description: Two-letter U.S. state or District of Columbia abbreviation; US is not accepted.

name: fbi_cde_state_crime_trend
